summary: Closure review: authors largely addressed prior reviewer comments (clarifying preregistration power assumption and explaining the McNemar outcome) and the run artifacts and analysis appear complete and consistent. One mandatory disclosure remains missing: the manuscript does not explicitly report that the model sampling temperature was unset (temperature=null) nor state the inferential implication that sampling determinism is unspecified. This disclosure can and must be added using the archived model_configuration.json artifact as authoritative evidence. After that single required change the manuscript should be acceptable for finalisation.
critical_issues: Missing explicit disclosure that model sampling temperature was unset in the recorded model configuration (execution/model_configuration.json shows temperature=null) and that null does not imply deterministic (temperature=0). The manuscript must explicitly state this fact and its inferential implication (sampling determinism unspecified) in Methods and in the Disclosure Statement, citing the archived model_configuration.json artifact (path and hash) as the authoritative source.
required_revisions: Add an explicit statement in Methods that model sampling temperature was unset: execution/model_configuration.json records "temperature": null (sha256: 1acce92558edeb13cd97b75817329d332afe4a36d01d566f1a26c61b132923fa). State that a null/unset temperature is not evidence of deterministic sampling and thus sampling determinism was unspecified; discuss briefly the inferential implication (i.e., that sampling nondeterminism could affect generator variance and that temperature was not fixed to force deterministic outputs).
Add the same explicit disclosure text (concise) to the Disclosure Statement, citing the same artifact path & hash as authoritative evidence.
optional_revisions: Optionally include a one‑sentence pointer to the single corrected discordant episode (pair-000229) and its archived validator/repair trace (artifact path in execution manifest) to aid reader understanding.

Optionally add a very short sentence or mini-table converting absolute paired improvements into required discordant‑pair counts for N=300 (e.g., absolute +0.30 ≈ 90 net discordant pairs) to help readers relate power planning to practical task design.
